A.text: Defective restorations are named as a local factor that can increase periodontal disease risk, along with caries lesions and malocclusion.

cites.section: Periodontal Conditions in Pediatric Dental Patients › High risk

B.text: Immunosuppressive or radiation therapy is listed as a biological risk factor, not a local one.

cites.section: Periodontal Conditions in Pediatric Dental Patients › Biological factors

C.text: Nutritional deficiencies are listed among the biological risk factors.

cites.section: Periodontal Conditions in Pediatric Dental Patients › Biological factors

D.text: Pregnancy is listed as a biological risk factor.

cites.section: Periodontal Conditions in Pediatric Dental Patients › Biological factors

E.text: Mental health disorders such as stress and depression are listed as biological risk factors.
